parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and disseminate an access control policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, and compliance. Review and update the access control policy at least annually.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Define and document information system account types. Assign account managers. Establish conditions for group and role membership. Identify authorized system users and specify access authorizations. Require manager approval for account creation requests.

controls.title: Account Management | Automated System Account Management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Support the management of information system accounts using automated mechanisms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability Policy and Procedures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and disseminate an audit and accountability policy that addresses purpose, scope, roles, and responsibilities.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging. Coordinate the event logging function with other entities requiring audit information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ensure that audit records contain information about the type of event, when it occurred, where it occurred, the source of the event, the outcome, and the identity of individuals or subjects.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and disseminate a configuration management policy and procedures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the information system under configuration control.
